text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ACTIVE: rapid attach failures and GPU capacity gridlock in gcp-us-west1. Autoscaler reports attach_denies=503 (1m), queue_depth=850 for gen/embeddings routes. Paging SRE rotation @jamie and infra @priya. Runbook: /runbooks/gpu-attach-gridlock

jamie: On it. jumping into metrics and cloud console now. linking runbook I/O.

priya: checking quotas and project state: `gcloud compute project-info describe --project=redwood-inference-prod` then region quotas for us-west1.

luis: customer-impact: CS flagged 2 enterprise accounts (acct-A, acct-B) seeing 5xx spikes and >7s tail latency on chat completions. Non-enterprise traffic experiencing heavy queueing.

meera: quick mitigation idea — reroute non-SLA traffic to us-west2, and enable a temporary preemptible burst pool in us-west1 to relieve attach backpressure.

jamie: autoscaler stuck because GPU quota for us-west1 == 100 (limit). current allocation=100. GCP console shows soft-limit reached. Opening quota increase request now: https://console.cloud.google.com/iam-admin/quotas?project=redwood-inference-prod -> request id 78921 (submitted).

priya: good. while quota increase is pending (GCP ETA ~2-4h), we need an immediate fallback. Plan: 1) reroute ~40% non-SLA traffic to us-west2, 2) spin up `burst-west1-preempt` pool of preemptible GPUs, 3) evict warm pools from low-priority batch jobs, 4) throttle background batch ingestion and reduce batch sizes.

meera: quickly dropping batch size for heavy embedding jobs: set BATCH_MAX_TOKENS=1024 -> `service config set embeddings.batch_max_tokens=1024` for non-SLA routes. That should free ~15-20% capacity for real-time calls.

ops-bot: Starting traffic-reroute job id=job-20260317-01: `trafficctl reroute --from=us-west1 --to=us-west2 --percent=40 --routes=non-sla`

ops-bot: Reroute job job-20260317-01 completed: 40% traffic now routed to us-west2.

priya: spinning up burst pool: `k8s apply -f burst-preempt-west1.yaml` -> creating nodepool preemptible-gpu-16x. Watch for preemption churn but should reduce attach backlog.

jamie: evicting warm pools for low-priority workloads: `infractl pool evict --label=priority:low --age>1h` — starting now.

luis: CS update: notified acct-A and acct-B with preliminary status and ETA ~2-4h. We offered degraded-mode fallback (smaller model) — they accepted for acct-B.

meera: implementing degraded fallback for non-enterprise: switch to quantized-variant `gpt-neoq-8k-q4` for non-SLA routes to reduce GPU memory pressure. Patching routing table now.

ops-bot: burst pool nodes became Ready. Preemptible nodes added: +48 GPUs to us-west1 transient capacity.

jamie: metrics check: attach_denies down from 503 -> ~72/min, queue_depth down 850 -> 220. Latency for most traffic improved to ~2.1s. Still seeing embedding backlog for acct-A.

priya: taking lead on escalation to eng-infra for long-term changes. Paging @oncall-bot for infra rotation takeover. Handing off to infra: jamie -> priya.

oncall-bot: Infra oncall notified: severity escalated to Sev2, page to rotation-priya. Follow up in 15m.

priya: current action list (in-progress):
- keep reroute to us-west2 until autoscaler healthy
- maintain burst-preempt pool for next 2 hours
- throttle background batches and reduce batch sizes
- monitor preemption impact and move long-running jobs out
- follow up with GCP quota request id 78921 (support ticket opened)

luis: Customer impact update 15m: acct-B switched to degraded cheaper model, latency stable. acct-A still experiencing delayed embeddings; CS escalation ongoing. No new customers reporting incidents.

jamie: diagnostic notes: attach_denies caused mostly by quota limit + simultaneous warm pool reclaim causing attach storm. We should add circuit breaker to avoid large simultaneous warm pool scaleups when region at >=95% quota. Filing follow-up bug: INF-1248.

priya: confirmed. I'll own postmortem and fix plan: 1) add quota-aware autoscaler backoff, 2) implement routing fallback policy per-account, 3) throttle warm-pool growth when quota>=90%.

ops-bot: Traffic reroute revert job scheduled at +2h unless manually extended. Job id job-20260317-01-rollback.

luis: CS will send follow-up note to affected customers after we stabilize.

jamie: attach_denies now ~12/min, queue_depth ~80. Keep monitoring dashboards (infra/gpu/attach and infra/queues). If things worsen, escalate to Sev1.

oncall-bot: Status update captured. Next update in 30 minutes.

meera: quick reminder — adjusting model quantization and batch sizes may slightly degrade output quality; we should surface that in customer comms.

priya: handing to eng-infra for cleanup and corrective actions. I'll post a concise incident summary and own the postmortem.

cs-lead: Thx team. CS will follow up with affected accounts and log the customer-impact notes.

jamie: Thanks all — good job moving quickly. Will reconvene for postmortem after quota resolution and stability confirmed.
